text:
alex: Heads up — sampleapp prod just showed duplicate webhook deliveries after our retry change. Repro looks like: request -> 429 -> SDK backoff -> token refresh races -> retry without idempotency header -> duplicate processing. Logs excerpt below:

alex: ```
2026-03-22T18:12:04Z GET /v1/process 429 retryable
2026-03-22T18:12:04Z token-refresh start (user-session)
2026-03-22T18:12:04Z token-refresh success
2026-03-22T18:12:05Z RETRY attempt=1 idempotency=none -> 200 (processed)
2026-03-22T18:12:06Z RETRY attempt=2 idempotency=none -> 200 (processed)
```

maria: Which SDK + version? We pushed an auth-retry tweak last week.

alex: Node SDK 1.8.2 running our sampleapp. Flow: initial request gets 429, SDK schedules backoff, meanwhile auth refresh completes and the original request path gets retried twice because our safe-replay guard didn't kick in.

sam: Ouch. Two things here: (1) require an Idempotency-Key per logical operation so backend can dedupe, and (2) improve observability so we can attribute duplicates to retry vs user re-trigger. Right now telemetry lumps everything.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: add retry labels to metrics: `retry_reason` (429|network|5xx|auth), `retry_count`, and `idempotency_present` (true|false). Also expose a histogram `retries_per_operation`. That helps spot spikes when token rotation coincides with 429 bursts.

alex: Current backoff config I used in sampleapp: `base=100ms, factor=2, max=5s, jitter=0.3`. With 429 bursts across many clients that still causes synchronized retries. Switching to full jitter helped in my local repro.

sam: Another parity bug: Python SDK auto-attaches `Idempotency-Key` for POSTs when caller sets `idempotent=true`. Node didn't follow that pattern, so many Node callers ended up without keys. We should harmonize behavior across SDKs.

kevin: Can we also emit an attempt header like `X-Retry-Attempt` and a `X-Replay-Id` per logical op for tracing in the backend? Then we can filter duplicates easily in logs and dashboards. Also add a metric `duplicates_by_retry_reason`.

alex: Quick patch we tried in sampleapp (pseudo):

alex: ```js
// sampleapp: ensure idempotency header on retryable ops
const id = generateUuid();
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id } });
// attach X-Replay-Id per attempt for tracing
fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Replay-Id': `${id}:${attempt}` } });
```

maria: Love it. Can someone open a minimal PR + sampleapp demo that simulates token rotation during a 429 window? If we have a failing integration test that deterministically reproduces the dupes we can gate a fix. I'll prioritize review.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the PR. Suggest we also add a config flag `safe_replay_window=25s` in sampleapp so tests can assert duplicate counts drop when idempotency is present. We'll add telemetry counters `duplicate_count` + `duplicate_by_reason`.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: sampleapp/ci #1234 — integration tests will include the replay simulation.

kevin: Quick follow-up: prefer `full` jitter strategy and a small random delay on token refresh callbacks to avoid immediate simultaneous retries. We'll document recommended defaults in devex notes.

maria: Good plan. I'll open a short doc in repo: `devex/retries.md` with examples for SDKs, recommended backoff (base=50ms, max=10s, jitter=full), and mandatory `Idempotency-Key` guidance.

alex: Thanks folks — once PR is up ping me and I'll run it against the prod-like load test that exposed the issue.
